news.title: viable/strict/1793050065: Serialize ninja per build directory instead of splitting it (#192251)
news.dek: setuptools gives every extension of a project the same  build_temp , and  build_ext -j  compiles them in threads, so two of them write  build.ninja  and run ninja in that one directory at the same time. The second build file replaces the first, and all but one extension comes out
news.aiSummary: Setuptools assigns the same build_temp directory to all extensions, and when building with parallel jobs, multiple extensions write to the same build.ninja file. This race condition causes one build file to overwrite another, so only one extension builds correctly. The issue arises from concurrent writes to a shared build directory.

news.title: GHARP: Real-Time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-Scale Reconstruction Prior
news.dek: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a repres
news.aiSummary: GHARP is a new technique that animates 3D human heads in real time from only a few input images and a driving expression signal. The method separates the task into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject and a motion stage that applies the expression. It relies on a large‑scale reconstruction prior to achieve realistic, real‑time results.
